title: Small Group Niagara Wine Tour from Toronto with Lunch
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off in the downtown Toronto area
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Escape the city and discover Niagara Wine Country on this small-group wine tour from Toronto. Travel in comfort to Niagara-on-the-Lake and visit three award-winning wineries, where you'll enjoy guided tastings featuring premium VQA wines and Canada's famous Icewine.

Enjoy a relaxing lunch in Niagara wine country and take in the beautiful vineyard scenery that has made this region one of North America's top wine destinations. Along the way, learn about local winemaking traditions and Niagara's unique cool-climate wines.

Designed for travelers who want a genuine wine country experience without the hassle of driving, this tour includes convenient Toronto pickup, premium tastings, and a carefully selected winery itinerary.

Perfect for couples, friends, and wine lovers looking for a memorable day trip from Toronto.
